response.rationale: The Recipe section first instructs building the container with 'docker build -t <your-astro-image-name> .', noting 'This will output an image, which you can run locally', and then says 'To run your image as a local container, use the following command: docker run -p <local-port>:<container-port> <your-astro-image-name>'. The image run locally is therefore the one produced by the preceding build command, not the Alpine alternative base or the Node base image.
